panel_description_zh: 中景平视斜对角，妻子停下脚步回头望向床方向；一只手叉腰；脸是 3/4 侧面，能看到眉压紧、嘴闭紧；背景客卧米白色遮光帘尚未被扯开，帘缝里能看见窗外的模糊阳光。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 我跟你说话你当没听见是吧

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot on a slight diagonal angle of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman who has stopped mid-stride and turned her head back over her shoulder toward the bed direction (husband is in bed). One hand resting on her hip. Face shown in three-quarter side view, the scowl still locked in place: eyebrows drawn down and inward at the bridge forming a hard scowl, eyes narrowed to slits looking back at the bed, mouth closed with lips pressed together, jaw visibly clenched. Long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, a single pearl stud earring visible, small gold locket at neckline, hair slightly loosened from the recent burst. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top tucked into light grey high-waisted yoga leggings, fluffy-cuff light grey memory-foam house slippers, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the hand on her hip. Background: the bedroom's beige blackout curtain still closed across the window, a few faint warm daylight leaks at the curtain seam, plain white bedroom wall. Cold blue-grey bedroom interior with a sliver of warm light at the curtain seam. Mood: the scolding has started. Text watermark 'P03-PN03' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in bed, decorative hallway art, daylight from a side window, soft flattering lighting
